sloka: विरराज महाकायो महावीर्यो महामनाः ।पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशो विधूम इव पावकः ।। ६.५६.२८ ।।।।
transliteration: virarāja mahākāyo mahāvīryo mahāmanāḥ ।puṣpitāśokasaṅkāśo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ ।। 6.56.28 ।।।।

translations.english: The gigantic Hanuman, exceedingly valiant and courageous one shone like a fully blossomed Ashoka tree, resembled smokeless fire.
